dogecoin.text: Bitcoin Dips Below $86K: Crypto markets saw a shake-up today as Bitcoin fell 1.8% to $85,925, while Ethereum dropped 5.1% to $1,923. Altcoins like Dogecoin (-7%) and Solana (-3.7%) also took hits.

Market Outlook: Altcoins like Dogecoin (up 8.6%) and Sui (up 11.7%) followed Bitcoin’s rally, with the CoinDesk 20 Index up 5.2%. However, CryptoQuant’s bearish on-chain score suggests a potential pullback if sentiment shifts.
